messages:
erin: Quick q — PR #3498 touches eng-runtime/kernels and eng-ml/eval/telemetry. CODEOWNERS has eng-runtime for /runtime/** and eng-ml for /eng-ml/** but this PR also modifies infra/configs/serving.yaml which doesn't map cleanly. Who can sign off on a cross-module touch? Need to merge today for the release window.

sam: can you paste the changed paths?

erin: sure, diff paths: ```
modified: runtime/kernels/kernel_dispatch.cpp
modified: eng-ml/eval/telemetry/metrics_collector.py
modified: infra/configs/serving.yaml
```

maria: If infra/configs/ isn't covered by CODEOWNERS it's effectively unowned and falls to platform/infra. I don't see eng-platform listed. @lex is on the runtime owner rotation this week if that helps.

lex: I can take a look now. If the infra change is just a new default and tests pass I'm fine approving. Can someone ping QA for a quick sanity check?

ci-bot: CI: integration-tests (flaky) failed on first run, requeued job 789 -> retrying.

sam: tagging @cody — I think you touched infra/configs last quarter, any concerns?

cody: I own infra/configs. Quick skim: the new `batching.window_ms` param looks safe and has a sane default. No security impact. I'll approve once CI passes.

maria: Side note — we should add a CODEOWNERS entry for infra/configs (ops/infrastructure) so mixed PRs don't stall. Filed ops issue: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/412 — proposed owner: @cody.

erin: great call, I'll follow up with a separate PR to add the CODEOWNERS entry. Lex, Cody — can you both approve this PR so I can merge after CI green?

lex: approved :thumbsup:

cody: approved — merging after CI completes.

erin: merged and pushed release tag v1.23.5 — thanks everyone! :tada:
